knowledge:
- key_parameters: ch1=First channel/parameter of interest (default "FS.Log") ;; ch2=Second channel/parameter of interest (default "FL.4.Log") ;; x_start, x_end, y_start, y_end=Gate boundaries to cut out noise (default 0 to 4095) ;; xbin=Number of bins within the histogram representing resolution (default 128) ;; maxv=Maximal value of expressions set to black (default 200, recommended 130-200) ;; verbose=If TRUE, writes overlap and XOR results to text files ;; group=Data frame assigning samples to groups (up to 25 groups) ;; abiotic=Data frame of environmental parameters to overlay on NMDS ;; p.max=Significance threshold for plotting abiotic parameters (default 0.05) ;; show_cluster=If TRUE, displays a cluster dendrogram alongside the NMDS plot
- alternatives: flowCyBar (can be used to obtain gate information to detect influences from specific subpopulations)
- when_to_use: When evaluating large cytometric datasets of complex microbial communities or other cell populations quickly, automatically, and person-independently, without manual gate setting or binning.
- pitfalls: Requires highly calibrated datasets (e.g., using fluorescent beads) because any cytometer adjustment shift will affect the outcome ;; Requires the same number of cells to be measured for every sample ;; The order and number of lines in the abiotic data frame must be identical to the order and number of samples printed in R, otherwise association will fail.

workflows.name: flowchic_image_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform cytometric histogram image comparison (CHIC) on FCS files to analyze microbial community dynamics using image overlap/XOR calculations and NMDS visualization.
input: abiotic_incol (optional data frame of abiotic parameters)
workflows.stages: 1. Read FCS files and check channel names using read.FCS ;; 2. Generate histogram images using fcs_to_img ;; 3. Create subset images to exclude noise using img_sub ;; 4. Calculate overlap and XOR values using calculate_overlaps_xor ;; 5. Plot similarities using plot_nmds
workflows.code:
files <- list.files(getwd(),full=TRUE,pattern="*.fcs")
frame <- read.FCS(files[1],alter.names=TRUE,transformation=FALSE)
unname(frame@parameters@data$name)
fcs_to_img(files)
fcs_to_img(files,ch1="SS.Log",ch2="FL.1.Log")
img_sub(files,ch1="FS.Log",ch2="FL.4.Log")
img_sub(files,x_start=200,x_end=3500,y_start=1000,y_end=3000,maxv=160)
subsets <- list.files(path=paste(getwd(),"chic_subset",sep="/"),full=TRUE,pattern="*.png")
results<-calculate_overlaps_xor(subsets)
calculate_overlaps_xor(subsets,verbose=TRUE)
plot_nmds(results$overlap,results$xor)
Results_overlaps<-read.table("Results_overlaps.txt",header=TRUE,sep="\t")
Results_xor<-read.table("Results_xor.txt",header=TRUE,sep="\t")
plot_nmds(Results_overlaps,Results_xor)
groups<-data.frame("groups"=c(15,19,19,19,15,22,19,15,22,15,15,22,22,22,22,19,19))
plot_nmds(Results_overlaps_incol,Results_xor_incol,group=groups)
plot_nmds(Results_overlaps_incol,Results_xor_incol,abiotic=abiotic_incol[,-1])
plot_nmds(Results_overlaps_incol,Results_xor_incol,group=groups,legend_pos="topright",abiotic=abiotic_incol[,-1],p.max=0.01,col_abiotic="darkred")
plot_nmds(Results_overlaps_incol,Results_xor_incol,show_cluster=TRUE,group=groups,legend_pos="topright",abiotic=abiotic_incol[,-1],p.max=0.01,col_abiotic="darkred")
plot_nmds(Results_overlaps_incol,Results_xor_incol,show_cluster=TRUE,group=groups,legend_pos="topright",abiotic=abiotic_incol[,-1],p.max=0.01,col_abiotic="darkred",verbose=TRUE)
